title: Service Administrator
description: Service Administrator Location: Leatherhead Salary: Competitive (DOE) Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm Overview We are seeking an organised and customer-focused Service Administrator to join a busy service operations team. This role is responsible for coordinating engineers, scheduling maintenance works, managing service requests, and ensuring jobs are completed efficiently from initial booking through to invoicing. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator with experience working in a fast-paced service environment. A key requirement is proven experience coordinating and scheduling engineers and acting as a central point of contact between clients, suppliers, contractors, and field-based technical teams. Key Responsibilities - Coordinate and schedule reactive and planned maintenance work for engineers. - Manage engineer diaries and ensure service levels are maintained. - Monitor planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and ensure works are completed on time. - Act as the first point of contact for incoming calls from customers, suppliers, contractors, and engineers. - Arrange site access for engineers and subcontractors. - Order parts and materials as required. - Process purchase invoices and assist with job completion and invoicing. - Provide regular updates to customers on job progress and completion status. - Produce reports, maintain databases, and support administrative processes. - Verify engineer timesheets and expenses where required. - Maintain accurate records, filing systems, and service documentation. Essential Skills & Experience - Previous experience coordinating, scheduling, or dispatching engineers is essential. - Experience working within a service desk, helpdesk, facilities management, engineering, maintenance, or similar operational environment. - Strong customer service and communication skills. - Comfortable liaising with customers, suppliers, contractors, and mobile engineering teams. - Excellent organisational skills and ability to prioritise a high volume of work. - Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook. - Strong attention to detail and administrative skills. - Professional telephone manner and excellent written and verbal English. title: Customer Service Order Processor
description: Customer Service Order Processor - Temporary We are looking for a cheerful and professional Customer Service Order Processor to join our team client in Staines. If you thrive in a fast-paced setting and love helping customers, we want to hear from you! What You'll Do: As a Customer Service Order Processor, you will play a vital role in ensuring our clients customers have an exceptional experience. Your daily tasks will include: - Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently. - Responding to customer inquiries via phone and email with a friendly demeanour. - Collaborating with various teams to resolve issues and ensure timely delivery of products. - Maintaining accurate records of orders and customer interactions in our system. - Assisting with inventory management and stock queries. - Using JD Edwards to process orders efficiently. What We're Looking For: To succeed in this role, you should be: - Customer-Focused: You love connecting with customers and going the extra mile to meet their needs. - Detail-Oriented: Accuracy is key! You'll need to process orders and information with precision. - A Team Player: You enjoy working with others and can collaborate effectively to achieve common goals. - Adaptable: You can handle changing priorities and thrive in a busy environment. - Tech-Savvy: Comfortable using order processing software and other digital tools. What We Offer: - Temporary Contract: This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience in the manufacturing and production industry with a temporary contract for 6 months. - A Vibrant Work Environment: Join a team that values enthusiasm, collaboration, and fun while getting the job done! - Competitive Pay: We offer a competitive salary for your hard work and dedication. - Professional Development: Gain valuable skills and insights that will help you grow in your career. title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Job Description: We are seeking an energetic and dedicated Customer Service Advisor to join our clients dynamic team. In this role, you will be the frontline representative responsible for delivering exceptional service to their prestigious customers, ensuring their needs are met with enthusiasm and professionalism. Your proactive approach will help foster positive relationships, resolve inquiries efficiently, and contribute to a seamless customer experience. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess strong communication skills, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your career in customer service. Role and Responsibilities: - Engage with customers via phone and email to address inquiries, provide service information, and resolve issues promptly. - Utilise the inhouse operations system to provide quotes, manage bookings and to support invoice processing. - Provide track and trace information data to clients on request. - Contribute to team goals by participating in training sessions, sharing best practices, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. - Support and build strong relationships with our clients customer base. Requirements: - A minimum of 1 year experience in a customer service role is preferred from any industry. - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. - Demonstrated problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude towards resolving customer concerns. - IT proficiency in Word, Outlook and Excel. - Polite and professional telephone manner. Employee Benefits: Our client offers a range of benefits designed to support their employees financial wellbeing, health, professional development and work-life balance: - Free Onsite Parking - Workplace Pension Employer contributions to support your long-term financial planning. - Private Medical Insurance Available from January following the start of your employment. - Gym Benefit Access to a gym benefit to support your health and wellbeing. - Electric Vehicle Scheme Access to an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme. - Cycle to Work Scheme A tax-efficient way to purchase a bicycle and cycling equipment for commuting. - Working from Home Allowance 20 days available to eligible office-based employees. - Training & Professional Development Opportunities for training, professional qualifications and ongoing career development. - Technology & Equipment A company mobile phone and laptop provided where required for your role. This is an excellent role within a friendly, professional and ever growing business.
